path_base: All paths are relative to the research repository root (/Users/fengruiding/Downloads/3d_code), not to the website repository or this file.
scope: Read-only mapping of existing paper figures to local archived sources and renders. No Blender execution, source-program changes, or remote operations were performed.
notes: The five published PNGs and listed generated figures have identical decoded RGB pixels. File SHA-256 hashes differ because PNG encoding or metadata differs.

Source existence is verified at mapping time; the figure manifests do not provide historical source hashes, so existence is not proof that a source program is byte-identical to its original render-time version.

TreeStruct3D renders change selected PART_PARAMS scale entries in an in-memory AST and then execute the original Blender program to rebuild geometry. The worker may apply recorded compatibility transforms; it never edits the source file on disk.
All displayed edits independently vary one side at 0.4 or 1.6 while keeping the other side at 1.0. These are not new validation results.
The appendix selection manifest retains an old review_only_not_integrated label; its output images were independently matched to the repository figures by exact RGB comparison.
Actual gemeni/gemini directory spellings are preserved.

parent_ids and child_ids are the paper edit roles, not a guarantee of Blender runtime object-parent direction. Shared semantic part IDs can identify multiple repeated instances and must be expanded using part_id when exporting runtime geometry.
